subject: Musician Life Under COVID US vs Canada
overview: The program featured a comparison of the financial and social safety nets available to musicians in Somerville and Toronto during the COVID-19 pandemic. Participants discussed the differences between American mutual aid and Canadian federal income support programs.

items.title: Introduction to Solidarity Live
items.summary: Anna Callahan introduced the program as a community forum designed to share stories and solve problems through expert discussion.

items.title: Financial impact on Somerville musicians
items.summary: James Lesuey described the total loss of his performance and restaurant income, noting his reliance on local mutual aid and a one-time stimulus check to cover expenses.

items.title: Economic support for musicians in Canada
items.summary: Kat McCleavey detailed her transition to online teaching and the availability of a $2,000 monthly federal benefit provided by the Canadian government.

items.title: Comparison of national health and safety policies
items.summary: Participants compared the impacts of single-payer healthcare and national rent protections on their personal safety and financial security during the public health crisis.
